title: knowledge(ui): define per-record page outputs on every control-flow path
summary: A new quality rule was added to detect when page outputs assigned conditionally in OnAfterGetRecord might retain values from previous records on skipped-assignment paths, with good and bad code examples.
key_points: Requires per-record page outputs to be defined on every control-flow path through OnAfterGetRecord
Covers list pages, part pages, and API page fields
Accepts initial clearing, unconditional defaults, complete conditional assignments, and helper initialization
Grounded in page-instance lifecycle documentation and Microsoft API patterns
Good example demonstrates clearing and complete-assignment variants; bad example uses conditional lookup retention
